entities.title: Ship qwen-chat in the release and the Homebrew formula
entities.summary: qwen-chat is built and tested in CI but left out of the release build, the universal binaries, signing, the tarball and the zazzle formula.
entities.details: The release builds both macOS targets on one runner with zazzled's PGO CFLAGS; the llama.cpp build with Metal has not been tried there, so release.yml excludes the crate until it has.
acceptanceCriteria: release.yml builds qwen-chat for aarch64 and x86_64 macOS and lipo joins them.
sign-and-notarize, the tarball, bottle.sh, formula.sh and formula.test.sh include qwen-chat.
The universal binary answers a question on an Apple-silicon Mac using Metal.

origin.description: Build: 'not yet part of the release tarball or the Homebrew formula.'
